up: Retrieve data for all molecules linked to the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3228010. For each molecule, return its ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Sort the results by the molecule's ChEMBL ID.
sql:
WITH linked_docs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cr.molregno
  FROM compound_records cr
  JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
  WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3228010'
)
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  md.max_phase,
  md.molecule_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM linked_docs ld
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON ld.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
ORDER BY md.chembl_id;
